content.json: Topics and repository filters are mutually exlusive. To filter for topics, deselect all repositories and vice versa

parameters.name: Orgs
parameters.query:
githubscanaudit 
| extend organization = todynamic(organization_s).login
| distinct tostring(organization)
| where isnotempty(organization)

parameters.name: Repositories
parameters.query:
githubscanaudit 
| extend repository = todynamic(repository_s).full_name
| extend organization = todynamic(organization_s).login
| where isnotempty(repository) and tostring(organization) in ({Orgs})
| distinct tostring(repository)

parameters.name: Topics
parameters.query:
let selection = dynamic([{Repositories}]);
githubscanaudit 
| extend repository = todynamic(repository_s)
| extend topics = repository.topics
| extend org = todynamic(organization_s)
| extend orgName = org.login
| extend reposAreNotSelected = array_length((selection)) == 0
| where topics <> "[]" and orgName in ({Orgs}) //and reposAreNotSelected
| mv-expand topics
| distinct tostring(topics)
| project topics

content.query:
let repositoriesList = dynamic([{Repositories}]);
let repoTopics = dynamic([{Topics}]);
let RepositoryVulnerabilityAlerts = githubscanaudit 
| extend EventType='Dependabot Alert'
| extend repository = todynamic(repository_s)
| extend repositoryfullname = repository.full_name
| extend alert = todynamic(alert_s)                     
| extend alertexternalidentifier= coalesce(alert.external_identifier, alert.security_advisory.ghsa_id, tostring(alert.number))
| extend Severity = tostring(coalesce(alert.severity, alert.security_advisory.severity, alert.security_vulnerability.severity))
| extend org = todynamic(organization_s)
| extend orgFullName = org.login
| extend topic = repository.topics
| mv-apply repoTopics, topic on (
  mv-expand topic
 | extend Out = topic in (repoTopics)
 | summarize topic = make_list(topic), Out= make_list(Out)
 | project Out, topic
)
| extend areReposSelected = array_length((repositoriesList)) == 0
| extend areTopicsSelected = array_length((repoTopics)) > 0
| where
  (repositoryfullname in (repositoriesList) and orgFullName in ({Orgs})) or
  (set_has_element(Out, areTopicsSelected) and areTopicsSelected)
| where action_s in ('create', 'created') and isnotempty(alertexternalidentifier)
| project EventType, Severity, orgFullName;

let CodeScanningAlerts = githubscanaudit 
| extend EventType='Code Scanning Alert'
| extend repository = todynamic(repository_s)
| extend repositoryfullname = repository.full_name
| extend alert = todynamic(alert_s)
| extend Severity = tostring(alert.rule.security_severity_level)
| extend org = todynamic(organization_s)
| extend orgFullName = org.login
| extend topic = repository.topics
| mv-apply repoTopics, topic on (
  mv-expand topic
 | extend Out = topic in (repoTopics)
 | summarize topic = make_list(topic), Out= make_list(Out)
 | project Out, topic
)
| extend areReposSelected = array_length((repositoriesList)) == 0
| extend areTopicsSelected = array_length((repoTopics)) > 0
| where
  (repositoryfullname in (repositoriesList) and orgFullName in ({Orgs})) or
  (set_has_element(Out, areTopicsSelected) and areTopicsSelected)
| where action_s in ('created') and (isnotempty(commit_oid_s) or isnotempty(alert_s)) and isnotempty(Severity) 
| project EventType, Severity, orgFullName, repositoryfullname;

let SecretScanningAlerts = githubscanaudit 
| extend EventType='Secret Scanning Alert'
| extend repository = todynamic(repository_s)
| extend repositoryfullname = repository.full_name
| extend alert = todynamic(alert_s)
| extend alertSecretType = alert.secret_type
| extend Severity = "high"
| extend org = todynamic(organization_s)
| extend orgFullName = org.login
| extend topic = repository.topics
| mv-apply repoTopics, topic on (
  mv-expand topic
 | extend Out = topic in (repoTopics)
 | summarize topic = make_list(topic), Out= make_list(Out)
 | project Out, topic
)
| extend areReposSelected = array_length((repositoriesList)) == 0
| extend areTopicsSelected = array_length((repoTopics)) > 0
| where
  (repositoryfullname in (repositoriesList) and orgFullName in ({Orgs})) or
  (set_has_element(Out, areTopicsSelected) and areTopicsSelected)
| where action_s in ('created') and isnotempty(alertSecretType)
| project EventType, Severity, orgFullName, repositoryfullname;
 union withsource="AllEvents" RepositoryVulnerabilityAlerts, CodeScanningAlerts, SecretScanningAlerts
| summarize  Count = count() by tostring(Severity)

content.query:
let repositoriesList = dynamic([{Repositories}]);
let repoTopics = dynamic([{Topics}]);
githubscanaudit
| extend repository = todynamic(repository_s)
| extend repositoryfullname = repository.full_name
| extend org = todynamic(organization_s)
| extend orgFullName = org.login
| extend topic = repository.topics
| mv-apply repoTopics, topic on (
  mv-expand topic
 | extend Out = topic in (repoTopics)
 | summarize topic = make_list(topic), Out= make_list(Out)
 | project Out, topic
)
| extend alert = todynamic(alert_s)
| extend url  = alert.url
| extend repo = todynamic(repository_s)
| extend repository = repo.name
| extend created_at = alert.created_at
| extend resolved_at = alert.fixed_at
| extend day = todatetime(resolved_at) - todatetime(created_at)
| where action_s in ('closed_by_user', 'fixed') and (isnotempty(commit_oid_s) or isnotempty(alert_s))
| extend areReposSelected = array_length((repositoriesList)) == 0
| extend areTopicsSelected = array_length((repoTopics)) > 0
| where
  (repositoryfullname in (repositoriesList) and orgFullName in ({Orgs})) or
  (set_has_element(Out, areTopicsSelected) and areTopicsSelected)
| summarize format_timespan(avg(day), 'dd:hh:mm:ss')
content.title: Mean Time to Resolution (dd:hh:mm:ss)

| mv-apply repoTopics, topic on (
  mv-expand topic
 | extend Out = topic in (repoTopics)
 | summarize topic = make_list(topic), Out= make_list(Out)
 | project Out, topic
)
| extend areReposSelected = array_length((repositoriesList)) == 0
| extend areTopicsSelected = array_length((repoTopics)) > 0
| where
  (repositoryfullname in (repositoriesList) and orgFullName in ({Orgs})) or
  (set_has_element(Out, areTopicsSelected) and areTopicsSelected)
| where isnotempty(alertexternalidentifier) and  action_s in ('create', 'created')
| summarize Total=count(Severity), Critical=countif(Severity=='critical'), High=countif(Severity=='high'), Medium=countif(Severity=='moderate'), Low=countif(Severity=='low') by tostring(Repository)
content.title: Alerts by Repo
